Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Refactor: improve code quality and robustness

- Add common/config.py with centralized configuration
  - Environment variables for URLs \(WONDERBOX_BO_URL, etc.\)
  - Configurable timeouts and retry settings
  - retry_on_failure decorator with exponential backoff
  - rate_limited decorator for request throttling

- Fix exception handling across all scrapers
  - Replace bare except clauses with specific exception types
  - Add proper logging for parse errors

- Improve frontend scrapers
  - Add retry logic to base_public_scraper
  - Implement full pagination for partner reviews
  - Use configuration constants for URLs and timeouts

- Security improvements
  - Remove hardcoded default username from app.py
  - Move all URLs to environment-configurable settings

- Code cleanup
  - Remove unused imports \(os, tempfile\)
  - Fix indentation issues in exception handlers

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
